output_text: Ansible roles/collections. Each role or module must focus on a single, well-defined task. Avoid monolithic roles. Dedicated `_info`/`_facts` info-gathering modules/tasks. All YAML files must begin with `---`. Use two spaces for indentation, never tabs. Necessary-only quotes; prefer single quotes, double for escaping/multiline. One space after key-value colons. Always use the structured map style for module parameters
